items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-11-18
items.q: Yeah I played some job with him too, Dr. Bechet.

ctx.x: Towards the river a couple of blocks. Down near where Dr. Bechet lived over in downtown a little bit in there.
Yeah I played some job with him too, Dr. Bechet. Oh yes. He wasn't the best drum horn player but he loved that horn. He sure loved his music.
